items.text: Real screens now. Open: drift along PayZapp's payment row → pull out → Wallet tile lifts → push in → HARD CUT at 124: same frame, tile is now Zapp Account.
Logo match cut: push into the tile's Zapp logo, cut at 178 to the same logo in the Zapp Account header, pull out.
Core idea: PayZapp racks in beside it; its payment row lifts, flies over and lands on Zapp's three actions, then dissolves into them.
One stop per decision, each lifting in depth while the rest dims: Cashpoints up top → Balance → Add Money (1.5×) → Auto-Load (20%) → locks → whip to the upgrade banner.
Pull out to hero angle with results, end card.
